title: kgf-nexus chart values
description: Validated by Helm on install, upgrade, template and lint. Top-level keys are closed so a misspelt section fails instead of being silently ignored; sections that pre-date this schema accept extra keys (backwards compatibility), the sections added with it are closed. Cross-field rules (existingSecret, image.tag, worker-pool releases (agents present, a shared issuer, NATS client material), the agents' control-plane TLS, NATS identities, PITR, apply-mode UID, GC delete confirmation, database TLS and runtime logins, GPU requests vs advertised capacity, shared ServiceAccounts, PDB vs replicas, result-store backend vs MinIO and cloud identity, tracing endpoint) are enforced by the templates with a message naming the fix.

agentKubernetes.description: The kubernetes executor (agentDefaults.kubernetes, overridden per agent).

migResourcePrefix.description: Joined to a MIG profile: nvidia.com/mig- + 1g.10gb.

taskNodeSelector.description: Node labels the TASK pods are pinned to (NEXUS_K8S_NODE_SELECTOR).

taskTolerations.description: Taints the TASK pods tolerate (NEXUS_K8S_TOLERATIONS): operator Equal with a value, or Exists.

secretKey.description: A key inside a Secret's data.

dbParams.description: libpq/pgx connection parameters; values are URL-encoded. Connection-identity keys (user, host, sslmode, ...) are refused by the templates.

components.description: What this release runs (ADR-0035). controlPlane.enabled=false is a worker-pool release: agents (and the cluster controller) only.

name.description: The registered cluster name (clusters.name, migration 0018's CHECK): NEXUS_CLUSTER_NAME on every Nexus process.

tag.description: An immutable tag (git SHA or release). Required; never latest.

digests.description: Per-component image digest (the release pipeline writes it with deploy/scripts/helm-image-digests.py). A pinned component renders <ref>:<tag>@<digest>.

caBundle.description: Root CA bundle for verify-ca/verify-full: a Secret OR a ConfigMap holding `key`.

revokePublicConnect.description: REVOKE CONNECT ON DATABASE FROM PUBLIC in the db-roles Job (F153).

groupRolePrefix.description: Per-installation service group roles <prefix>_scheduler ... (migration 0038, F153). Empty = the shared nexus_* roles. Fixed once applied.

pool.description: Per-service pool caps (NEXUS_DB_MAX_CONNS / NEXUS_DB_MIN_CONNS). Empty keeps each service's default.

perService.description: Pool caps for one connection key, overriding maxConns/minConns above for that service only (F160: the dag-engine usually needs more).

bucket.description: The result bucket -- or the Azure container under resultStore.backend=azblob.

image.description: S3 server image; pin by digest (OPERATIONS §22).

mcImage.description: Bucket-init client image (mc); the pinned Silo image bundles one.

resultStore.description: Result-store backend and credentials for api-gateway, the workflow-manager (sensors), the agents and artifact-gc. Cross-field rules (azure.account for azblob, a key Secret for shared-key, minio.enabled only with s3 static/auto) are template guards.

partSizeBytes.description: Multipart part / Azure block / GCS chunk size, the range the binaries accept (NEXUS_RESULT_STORE_PART_SIZE_BYTES): at least S3's 5 MiB minimum part, at most 512 MiB (one part is buffered per upload), a multiple of GCS's 256 KiB chunk.

account.description: Storage account name: 3-24 lowercase letters and digits.

clientId.description: Client ID (a GUID) of a user-assigned managed identity: NEXUS_AZURE_CLIENT_ID.

tracing.description: OpenTelemetry trace export (standard OTEL_* variables) for every Nexus process. endpoint is required when enabled (template guard).

samplerArg.description: Sampling ratio 0..1, as a string (the OTEL variable is a string).

publicEndpoint.description: NEXUS_TRACING_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT on api-gateway: inbound REST trace context becomes a link, not the parent.

componentTopology.description: NEXUS_COMPONENT_TOPOLOGY on the api-gateway: who sees the control plane's pods, nodes and cluster (ADR-0037 §4).

schedulers.description: At least one when the control plane is enabled: the default queue needs a scheduler or nothing is ever dispatched. Ignored by a worker-pool release.

replicasManagedByController.description: The cluster controller owns the replica count: once the Deployment exists, renders keep its live spec.replicas (in a control-plane release only while clusterController.enabled and apply.enabled).

executors.description: Comma-separated: subprocess (always offered by the agent), kubernetes (renders the kubernetes executor's configuration). docker is refused by the templates: the chart mounts no Docker daemon.

requestDevices.description: Request gpuCount devices of resourceName (default true). false = simulated capacity, which requires the label simulated=true.

heartbeatIntervalMs.description: Ignored: not rendered, never read by the agent (the control plane sets the heartbeat interval at registration, ADR-0005). Accepted so older values files still validate.

controlPlane.description: How the agents reach the worker gRPC endpoint (NEXUS_CONTROL_PLANE and its TLS).

address.description: host:port (or a gRPC target URI such as dns:///host:port) of the api-gateway's worker gRPC listener.

url.description: NEXUS_NATS_URL for the agents; empty = no NATS (the agents long-poll).

networkPolicy.description: Ingress default-deny for the control-plane pods, with explicit allows (off by default).

workspaceWorkers.description: KGF.Nexus workspace namespaces that get a worker key from the bootstrap job (development: a workspace's agents before KGF issues worker tokens). secretKey names the key in existingSecret.
